title: Dauntless Unbroken
description: Unbroken account information, recent fixes and issues still being investigated. Update your launcher and fully restart the game to load client fixes.

sections.title: Welcome to 1.10.5
sections.description: Use your existing Unbroken account key. Update your launcher and fully restart the game.

list: Game downloads use Cloudflare R2 with resume support and file verification.
Ramsgate, Training Grounds and Hunting Grounds are available.

sections.title: Accounts and cosmetics
sections.description: Existing accounts carry their inventory and progression into the new realm.

list: Legacy cosmetic records are converted to the item format used by 1.10.5 when inventory loads.
The conversion keeps recovery records and does not reset equipment or cells.
Main-shop cosmetic offers use Rams; the displayed price is checked again when purchasing.
Launcher 1.0.53 and newer include the shop-card fix for Rams prices and icons instead of the incorrect -1 Platinum display.
Recruit dye stays in the shop for its quest. Other main-shop offers rotate weekly.
Middleman fusion recipes take one hour. Existing timers are not restarted.

sections.title: Reliability fixes
sections.description: Recent updates include these corrections. Multiplayer reports still help us confirm every case.

list: Launcher 1.0.54 includes chat and friend-presence connection fixes, plus a Training Grounds hammer replication correction.
Linux package updates wait for installation to finish. Removing game content preserves extra files you added.
Reforging now permits the level-20 weapon XP reset. All seven weapon prestige tracks award Aetherhearts on subsequent reforges.
Quest dialogue and Training Grounds routing have been corrected.
Public matchmaking groups eligible requests for the same hunt; private hunts stay limited to you and your party.
Ordinary bounties no longer overwrite seasonal challenge slots. Daily and weekly challenge changes still need in-game verification.
Slayer Link reward pools accept Combat Merits and Aethersparks; missing pools are restored without resetting link progress.

sections.title: Issues under investigation
sections.description: After a problem, use launcher Settings > Help > Export to admins. Include the hunt, item or ability name and what happened.

list: Hunt timeouts, Escalation cancellations and party travel still need multiplayer verification.
Weapon meters, Thrax and chain-blade recovery, consumables, projectile damage and corruption-related zero-health states remain under investigation.
Omnicell visibility and activation, Radiant Escalation effects and Lightbound Koshai bubbles still need validation.
Missing cosmetics, bounty rewards, Trials and island unlocks, and Slayer Link reward display are being checked.
Please report any reforge that charges currency without resetting weapon XP or updating its Slayer's Path requirement.
Daily and weekly challenge completion, refresh and reward claims still need end-to-end in-game verification.
